title: [CQ-R13e] Certify bridge and network probes
description:
Objective: add certify checks that close CQ-R08's uncertified points, from the worker handoff on CQ-R13 (2026-10-26):
- host EOF on stdin propagates through `multipass exec --no-map-working-directory <name> -- sudo -n <supervisor> ...` with no pty, so the supervisor kills the job;
- frame bytes are exact in both directions;
- no guest identity can reach the host's daemon ports.

Split out of CQ-R13 (task-f4811a72) by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-30. It depends on CQ-R13d, for certify.mjs and its registry.

Deliverable: three checks appended to CERTIFY_CHECKS. They run in the certify VM, which has the real supervisor, after 'no-mounts' and before 'teardown'. Generate and materialize a small snapshot first, since the check mode needs a workspace.
- 'bridge-eof': a supervisor check session whose approved command blocks, such as `sleep 600`. The host closes stdin, and within a fixed bound the session must end with the supervisor's host-EOF exit (74). Pass or fail comes from the provider's exit, never from a local kill.
- 'bridge-framing':
  - guest to host: a check job writes a deterministic payload (python3 derives 2 MiB from a fixed seed). The host reassembles the output frames, and they must be byte-exact: the same sha256 the host computes itself.
  - host to guest: the R09c materialize digest check of the generated snapshot.
- 'guest-network':
  - From the check identity, in its private netns, a TCP connect to the host's gateway address on the daemon port must fail.
  - From the agent identity (`multipass exec <name> -- sudo -n -u moe-agent python3 -I -c <probe>`), the same connect must also fail.
  - The probe ports are a certify-owned listener on host 127.0.0.1 and, when a daemon is running, the port in the project's daemon.json, read-only.
  - The daemon's bind host is recorded, so a 0.0.0.0 bind (WSL agent mode) shows up as a failure.

Every probe argv is a fixed literal plus validated numbers, with no shell interpolation of guest data. Every outcome maps to a fixed code.

Tests in scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs use fake providers: each check's pass and fail mapping, and its argv. The native behavior is certified only by the operator run.

Out of scope:
- the containment, cancellation, recovery and canary checks;
- enabling verified-local;
- .moe edits.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs (on WSL: env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH)
definitionOfDone: 'bridge-eof' passes only when closing the host's stdin ends a blocked check session within its bound with the supervisor's host-EOF exit. Shown by tests with a fake provider for both outcomes.
'bridge-framing' passes only when a deterministic guest payload arrives byte-exact and a generated snapshot materializes with a matching digest. Shown by tests.
'guest-network' passes only when neither the check identity nor the agent identity can connect to the host's daemon port at the gateway address. A successful connect fails the check. Shown by tests.
Each probe's argv is fixed apart from validated numbers, and every outcome maps to a fixed code. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
